01 / Profile

About Me

I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering at Batangas State University (BatStateU).

My academic and project work centers around bridging the gap between digital systems and the physical world. I have a deep passion for end-to-end development: from wireframing high-fidelity, user-centered interfaces in Figma, to writing scalable full-stack application logic, and down to designing custom hardware enclosures, soldering circuits, and programming microcontrollers.

I thrive on solving complex, multidisciplinary engineering problems that require both software agility and hardware reliability. Whether it's optimization of robotic motion, interactive web canvas systems, or production deployments, I build with performance and clean code in mind.
